scope: Development events before the final evaluation freeze. These are engineering and pilot observations, not final benchmark measurements.

events.outcome: The sandbox blocked Torch package files. Elevated read access resolved the import; no replacement package download was needed.
rank_bm25 was absent. A tested positive-IDF BM25 implementation replaced that optional dependency.
Tests exposed an unavailable-service mock path. The retrieval adapter now rejects missing encode services explicitly.
Complete pilot retained locally. Wrong lookup arguments, repeated actions and no-source answers motivated development changes.
Candidate titles and lookup schemas were added; deployable no-source answers became abstentions. Planner utility changed before held-out evaluation.

Intentionally stopped before any held-out evaluation to reserve the decoder-start token, count plan attempts, preserve controller stopping reasons, seed Torch and verify cached row hashes. Checkpoints and summaries remain under ignored development-history storage.

A later development pass rejected every plan because the prompt requested an array but showed a single-object example. That development pass was stopped before the freeze, its summaries and source snapshot were preserved, and the example was corrected. The eight-question development probe is recorded separately in plan-schema-probe.json.
56 tests passed after the budget fixes; two publication-dependent checks were deferred until report and notebook creation. Final publication runs the complete suite again.

postfreeze_reporting_events: Displaying qualitative cases hit Windows cp1252 UnicodeEncodeError. The wrapper now uses UTF-8 stdout/stderr. UTF-8 predictions and frozen inference code were unchanged.

Initial qualitative selection repeated questions across methods. That selection is preserved locally; the final purposive review excludes previously sampled questions and covers 12 distinct question IDs.
cleanup: No files were deleted. Earlier traces and development summaries remain local. Not every intermediate failing test XML was retained; the session tool results and this revision record describe those checks.
